title: Manucurist receives minority investment from Medik8 backer Inflexion
summary: The long-term partnership between Manucurist and Inflexion aims to accelerate the nail care brand's international growth and reinforce its innovation capabilities, particularly in the US

extraction.key_fact: Manucurist가 투자사 Inflexion에서 소수 지분 투자를 받았다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Manucurist receives minority investment from Medik8 backer Inflexion
